project.title: The global WWTPs activated sludge microbe catalog GWASMC
project.description: This study conducted a large-scale excavation of microbes by reconstructing 24,534 metagenome-assembled genomes from 828 WWTP metagenomes and developed a comprehensive global WWTP activate sludge microbe catalog (GWSAMC) and gene catalog (GWASGC).
